Re-reviewed 16 November 2026 against current RustSec database 02e2517f457a359fc6d3440ea4560c8ea188fee8 and checksum-verified CLI/bundler/macOS signing sources. RSA >=0.10.0 is now patched upstream; the supported tauri-macos-sign 2.4.3 still constrains rsa to 0.9, including in newly published CLI 2.12.5/bundler 2.10.5. Do not claim no upstream RSA fix or force an unsupported API replacement. In the exact retained patched builder lock, RSA has only that parent, gated to macOS in both manifests. Actual Linux and Windows inverse build graphs contain no RSA. All signing-helper Rust references are the fresh private-key generation in certificate.rs:852 and PKCS8 serialization; no network-facing RSA decryption endpoint or owner signing key is used. RPM OpenPGP is removed, canonical builds reject signing credentials and updater signing uses isolated Minisign Ed25519. Full-lock scanning continues reporting this exact vulnerability and bounded not-affected assessment; no ignore or target filter. Reassess by 30 November 2026; evidence and exact source hashes in docs/SECURITY-REVIEW-2026-11-16.md.
